question: Why can even immense material wealth not equal the value of this kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
inference: Even an ocean full of jewels cannot match the value implied for this teaching.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a fused and unusual form; meaning inferred as beyond purchase
plain_english: Even if one possessed an ocean filled with jewels beyond purchase, such wealth would not compare.
